bio:
I'm a student at **Vanderbilt University** majoring in **Computer Science and Applied Mathematics**, with a minor in **Engineering Management**.

I build AI systems that turn messy data into decisions. As an ISM Research Scholar mentored by the Head AI Engineer at PGA of America, I built B.A.A., a business-analytics assistant that improved client response times by 37% and cut manual processing in half. As an AI engineering intern at CampusConnect.AI, I engineered a recommendation engine that lifted engagement 62% across 200+ students. My Kaggle models rank in the top 15% of 10,000+ competitors, and through Thanuja.AI I have taught 1,000+ people to use AI.

My long-term goal is to lead engineering teams that build reliable, well-designed products. Studying engineering management alongside computer science and mathematics prepares me to pair strong technical skills with sound planning and collaboration.
currentFocus: Building AI-assisted web apps and looking for software engineering internships.
